demo_bcp_001: Mirela Ostvan (1921-1998) was an Oskerian cellist born in Hadley. She studied at the Velmaran Conservatory under Oren Vasse and in 1949 founded the Hadley String Quartet.
demo_bcp_002: The Hadley String Quartet gave its first concert in the Hadley Corn Exchange in 1950. Its founder, the cellist Mirela Ostvan, led it for thirty-one years.
demo_bcp_003: The painter Teodor Lusk married the cellist Mirela Ostvan in 1952; they had two daughters.
demo_bcp_004: Teodor Lusk painted the ceiling of the Port Ilse ferry terminal in 1960.
demo_bcp_005: The Selm bridge at Hadley was rebuilt twice, in 1888 and in 1934.
demo_bcp_006: The Amberly Regatta has been held at Port Ilse every August since 1871. The 1950 regatta drew a crowd of 12,400.
demo_bcp_007: Captain Joran Ilvas won the Amberly Regatta three times, in 1948, 1950 and 1953, sailing the cutter Grey Heron.
demo_bcp_008: The cutter Grey Heron was built at the Brannoch yard in 1931.
demo_bcp_009: The Brannoch yard, on the Varrow estuary, built fishing boats and cutters until it closed in 1962.
demo_bcp_010: The Morrowfen Observatory was founded in 1897 by the astronomer Liesl Varga, who discovered the comet that bears her name in 1903.
demo_bcp_011: Comet Varga returns every 71 years; its last perihelion was in 1974.
demo_bcp_012: Before she founded the observatory, Liesl Varga taught mathematics at the Velmaran Lyceum.
demo_bcp_013: The Velmaran Lyceum, founded in 1820, is the oldest secondary school on the island of Oskeria.
demo_bcp_014: The Oskerian poet Anselm Drey published his first collection, Salt Lanterns, in 1931, and was the island's first poet laureate, from 1958 to 1970.
demo_bcp_015: Anselm Drey was born in Port Ilse in 1907, the son of a ferry captain.
demo_bcp_016: A plaque on Harbour Street in Port Ilse marks the house where the poet Anselm Drey lived from 1940 until his death.
demo_bcp_017: The lighthouse at Cape Vardequist was automated in 1977, ending ninety years of resident keepers.
demo_bcp_018: The Gulf of Amberly ferry line between Velmaran and Port Ilse opened in 1902 and still runs four crossings a day.
demo_bcp_019: Davin Kesh, a cellist from Hadley, founded the Port Ilse Conservatory in 1880.
demo_bcp_020: Birds of the Brannoch marshes: the grey heron nests in the reed beds every spring.
